notes.title: Build 0.4.3.18.1 Hotfix is now live
notes.notes:
Buca's goal is weekly updates but lots of great feedback and bugs are popping up with the influx of new players so he wanted to start addressing some of these right away.

Features:
    - Multiplied the aim sensitivity range by 4 as there was not enough range for controllers and also low end mice (your saved sensitivity will likely be effected).

Gameplay Changes:
    - None

Bug Fixes:
    - Removed a loud horn sound that occurred for some players when hosting a local game.
    - Attempted to fix a mouse issue where the mouse would leave the game window (fix unconfirmed).
    - Fixed the "coundown" spelling error during the match countdown.

Known Issues:
    - First time running the game there is often a problem where available keybinds and screen resolutions do not appear correctly - restart the game to fix.
    - The keybind screen is little wonky at times (order moves around by itself) but seems to get the job done.
    - Chat box has an issue after your first message. Clicking between each chat message seems to clear it up
    - Some character animations are not working at the right time (like walking instead of skiing or vice versa).
    - Some character jetpack locations are not aligned yet.
    - Slapping the ball quickly between players causes a multiverse infinite possibilites scenerio with some interesting results.
    - The brake key has been known to stick for at least one player (hitting brake again fixes it).
    - After changing teams, players can see both team messaging waypoints indicators (when you should only see your own team message waypoints).
    - The mouse goes inverted sometimes when playing with sensitivity - workaround is to check the invert mouse box (until you restart then it will correct itself requiring you to unchkeck the box)
